snippet.title: Maple & Aluna Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Fight together as Maple and Aluna in this action-adventure roguelike. Slaughter foes, capture altars, and augment yourself with powerful mystics to survive the eternal winter.

Try the itch demo: https://agoninteractive.itch.io/maple-and-aluna
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149680
